reason: It's brand new, so there are no Play Store ratings or Reddit threads for me to check, and I don't pay for apps I can't look up first. At most I'd poke at the free tier, and I already know I'd drop it after a week like every other tracker I've set up.
objection: I won't keep it up after the first week. Building the app is the easy part, actually logging stuff every day is where I always quit, and an AI setting it up doesn't fix that.
would_change_my_mind: A few months of solid 4.5+ ratings and Reddit posts from people my age saying they still use it daily, plus the free tier actually being enough to prove it sticks for me.
